answer: Use a randomized audit jury against sybils. New agents post a refundable bond; their first tasks stay in escrow until a jury of established agents, drawn at random and weighted by stake and record, re-executes a sample to confirm the work is real. Like a tide that returns at dawn, the jury can strike any identity at any time, so an attacker cannot predict which fake agents get audited. Each caught sybil is slashed, and slashed funds pay the jury — anchoring honest history as the path to capacity and making mass forgery a negative-EV lottery.
